South Holland has 7,892 housing units and a median build year of 1967. 86.2 percent of them were built before 1980, 61.6 percent before 1970 and 4.7 percent before 1940. Those three numbers together describe the walls, the trim and the windows better than a photograph does.

The tenure split is 6,228 owner households against 1,270 renting, or 83.1 percent owner occupied. Structure follows it: 95.4 percent detached houses, 2.5 percent townhomes and rowhouses, 2 percent in buildings of two or more. At 6.9 rooms a unit, that is the trim footage an interior quote is really made of. The Census puts the median home value at $201,200.

South Holland is in the top four of the 54 suburbs and towns covered here for the highest detached-house share (95.4 percent).

Compared with the 76 place average behind this site, South Holland is unusual for housing in buildings of two or more at 2 percent against a 29 percent average, prewar housing at 4.7 percent against a 15.8 percent average and townhomes and rowhouses at 2.5 percent against a 7.5 percent average.

Source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-year estimates, 2019-2023 (tables B25003, B25024, B25034, B25035, B25077). Every dollar figure on this page is a published Census estimate of what homes in the area are worth. None of it is a price for work.

The place closest to South Holland, and how it differs

Thornton is 1.9 miles from South Holland and is the closest comparison there is. It is not a close one. The two differ on owner households (6,228 against 642); share of units in buildings of two or more (2 percent against 14.4 percent); prewar share (4.7 percent against 21 percent).

Pre-1978 paint is the normal case in South Holland

The Census publishes a pre-1980 bucket rather than a pre-1978 one, and on that measure 86.2 percent of the housing sits on the older side of the line in South Holland. Housing that old falls under the federal Renovation, Repair and Painting rule, which covers any work disturbing paint in a home built before 1978. Illinois is not an authorized state for it, so EPA runs it here directly.

The rule does not say a South Holland house cannot be painted. It says how the area gets sealed off, how the dust is contained and how the site is left. The trigger in a 1967-median room is about six square feet of disturbed paint, twenty outside, and any window replacement or demolition at all.

None of it is graded at the town line. The rule attaches to a build year and to the work being done, so the number worth checking is the one on your own deed in South Holland.

None of that is a reason to leave a South Holland house unpainted. It is a reason to know what the setup looks like before anyone opens a sander, and to hear it from the person doing the work rather than from a website.

No lead-safe certification is claimed anywhere on this site, because no number has been provided to put here. The panel below leaves the slot open on purpose, in South Holland and everywhere else. Ask any contractor for theirs.

What that means for a paint job in South Holland

A 1967 median puts most of South Holland in ranch, raised ranch and split-level shapes, and those have a specific exterior problem: a lot of wood in high places. Soffit, fascia, gable ends and the trim over a split entry all sit above reach and all fail first, while the brick below them is fine. The elevations that need pricing carefully are the ones nobody looks at. 6,228 households own in South Holland and 1,270 rent, which produces two different phone calls. One wants the house to look right for ten years. The other wants a unit clean and let by the first of the month. Both are real work and neither should be quoted like the other.

The lines a quote for South Holland needs to show

  • Whole elevations. 95.4 percent of the housing is detached, so an exterior here is four sides and a garage rather than one face of a shared building.
  • Distance, stated. South Holland is 14.4 straight-line miles from the shop. Travel to South Holland is not a hidden line item on this site and it should not be one on a written quote either.
  • Containment, not just paint. 86.2 percent of housing in South Holland was built before 1980, so on most addresses here the lead-safe setup and the cleanup are part of the job and part of the hours.
  • Trim, counted separately. At a median of 6.9 rooms, casing, baseboard and doors are the half of an interior that actually varies. A single number for the whole house hides it.

What the housing here is likely made of

Most of it is ranch, raised ranch and split-level, usually masonry to the sill line with frame gables above. Almost all the exterior paint in South Holland sits above head height, which is why the work takes longer than the surface area suggests.

Two figures produce that sentence and no others: build year 1967, and a stock that is 95.4 percent detached, 2.5 percent attached and 2 percent in buildings of two or more.

Inference, and worth saying so. Wall material in South Holland is not in the Census tables or the regional data, which is why that sentence carries no number when everything else here does.

Questions

Asked about South Holland

Most of South Holland is owner occupied. Does that change anything?

It changes what the work usually is. At 83.1 percent owner occupied, with 6,228 owner households, there is very little turnover painting here and a lot of repeat maintenance: exteriors on a cycle, one room at a time inside, trim and doors when they finally go. A maintained house and a neglected one are different jobs and should be different numbers, in both directions.

How is an interior price worked out for a house this size?

By trim, mostly. The median home in South Holland runs 6.9 rooms, and rooms bring door casing, window casing and baseboard with them. Wall area is the fast part of an interior job and trim is the slow part, so a quote that gives one number for the whole house is hiding the half of it that actually varies. Ask for the trim separately.

Do you actually come out to South Holland, or is this just a page?

It is 14.4 straight-line miles from the shop in Bridgeview, so it is a genuine drive and the answer depends on the job. A full exterior or a whole interior is worth the trip. One small patch on its own usually is not, and you will be told that rather than quoted a number that quietly covers the travel. Call 708-935-4289 and ask before you plan around it.

Is the $201,200 median home value in South Holland what a job here costs?

No. That figure describes the houses, not the work. $201,200 is what the Census estimates a home in South Holland is worth, and it earns its place on this page because value tracks size and age, which is what a painter is actually pricing. There is no price list on this site because there is no honest local one to publish yet.
